dedupe_keys.name: potentialgebiete zur speicherung von wasserstoff in schleswig holstein

description: Potentialgebiete zur Speicherung von Wasserstoff in Schleswig-Holstein is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltgeodienste.schleswig-holstein.de. The distribution of salinary rocks worthy of investigation within the brine boundary for the installation of hydrogen/natural gas storage caverns and the maximum defensible depth of the brine roof are shown. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Potential areas for the storage of hydrogen in Schleswig-Holstein" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasserstoffspeicher, Karten, Untergrund-Nutzung, Speicherkavernen, ENVI, Salzstukturen. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
